description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP request object, including methods for constructing, manipulating, and retrieving request data such as method, URI, headers, and body.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 RequestInterface, representing an HTTP request with methods to set and retrieve request details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, constructing it from the URI if not explicitly set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified request target.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
